title: BI-PF-0394 (B1) missing epic back-reference: not a child of Epic B (BI-PF-0391)
body: BI-PF-0394 (B1 PF Go core) had an empty epic field and was absent from BI-PF-0391.children[], so B1 was orphaned from its Epic B container even though it is listed in the plan's EPIC B table.

rcca.root_cause: B1 was created/completed before the Epic<->children bidirectional model (ADR-0004) was enforced, so its epic back-reference and the container's children[] were never set.
rcca.corrective: Re-homed BI-PF-0394 to BI-PF-0391 via backlog.move_to_epic (single writer), which re-syncs both epics' children[].
rcca.preventive: backlog_epic_audit + _sync_epic_children keep epic/children consistent; new items are parented on create.
